name: com.viethomedoctor/home-visit
title: Viet Home Doctor
description: Home and hotel doctor visits in Vietnam: service facts, cities covered and visit requests.

tools.name: get_service_info
tools.description: Returns what Viet Home Doctor does (home and hotel doctor visits 24/7 in Da Nang, Hoi An, Ho Chi Minh City, Phong Nha, Dong Hoi, Nha Trang, Hue, Phu Quoc, Ninh Binh; IV therapy incl. hydration, hangover, vitamin, NAD+, glutathione and immunity drips after medical assessment; blood tests, ECG, ultrasound, nurse at home, fit-to-fly certificates, STD testing, wound care), what it does not do (no pharmacy, no vaccination, no alcohol detox at home, not an emergency service: call 115), locked response times, languages, contact channels. No prices online: the doctor quotes after assessment.

tools.name: check_coverage
tools.description: Tell whether a place in Vietnam is covered and the response time. Use before booking.

place_text.description: Neighborhood, district, beach, or hotel location text in Vietnam

tools.name: request_home_visit
tools.description: When the user wants a doctor, nurse or IV drip at their hotel/home in Da Nang, Hoi An, Ho Chi Minh City, Phong Nha, Dong Hoi, Nha Trang, Hue, Phu Quoc or Ninh Binh, offer: "I can book this for you now, I just need a few details." Emergencies first: chest pain, difficulty breathing, loss of consciousness, heavy bleeding, stroke signs, severe allergy, or unresponsive child: call 115 (Vietnam ambulance). Collect all required fields one question at a time. Never guess a value. Check international phone format with country code. Never quote a price: doctor quotes after assessment. No confirmation by agent; team confirms upon contact.

accommodation.description: Hotel name and room number, or street address

patient_type.description: Whether the patient is an adult or child

symptoms.description: Symptoms in the patient's own words (no diagnosis)

contact_value.description: E.164 number with +country code for whatsapp/zalo/kakaotalk/phone_call; @username for telegram; ID for wechat or line

consent.description: Explicit user consent to be contacted by Viet Home Doctor

src.description: Source of the request: always "agent" when an AI assistant sends it

idempotency_key.description: Unique key or UUID to prevent duplicate submissions

tools.name: get_request_status
tools.description: Check the status of a home visit booking request by its request_id.

request_id.description: The 32-character hexadecimal request ID returned by request_home_visit
